typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BatchId as decimal(0,0) (),
	BatchListResultSet as string (),
	BLIVCreateDttm as timestamp (),
	ExtractFileName as string (),
	ExtractFileNameFinal as string (),
	ExtractFilePath as string (),
	get_Batch as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	LoadTCDetail as string (),
	LoadTCHeader as string (),
	LoadTCTrailer as string (),
	LoadXML as string (),
	RowCount as integer (),
	strDataSource as string (),
	strInitialCatalog as string (),
	strPassword as string (),
	strSqlServerProvider as string (),
	strUserName as string (),
	Var_LastBatch as decimal(0,0) ()
}

source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '[Invoice].[Pr_GenerateXML_PDPInv_PSD] 	@BatchId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSRCTCXML	source(output(
		COUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ISNULL(CAST(TOTAL_REC_COUNT AS INT),0)  AS COUNT FROM [BOSS].[INVOICE].[PDPTRAILER] WHERE BATCH_ID= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBPSDCNT
OLEDBSRCTCXML derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DCTCXML
SRCOLEDBPSDCNT sink(input(
		COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COUNT)) ~> DSTFFPSDCNT
DCTCXML sink(input(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> FFDSTTCXML
